Motive+: Motivational To Do List & Goal Tracker

Motive+ is an elegant, motivation and goal tracking app designed to transform your aspirations into achievements. Stay motivated, build positive habits, track progress, and celebrate successes—all within a beautiful, distraction-free interface focused on your personal growth.

✨ Key Features
✓ Goal Tracker – Set, visualize, and achieve meaningful goals with proven psychology techniques 
✓ Habit Builder – Develop consistent routines that lead to lasting personal transformation 
✓ Progress Dashboard – Watch your growth with beautiful visual tracking and analytics 
✓ Motivation Library – Access daily inspiration and scientifically-backed motivation techniques 
✓ Smart Reminders – Get perfectly timed nudges to keep your momentum going
 ✓ Privacy First – Your personal journey stays private with no ads or trackers, ever!

🎯 Achieve Your Goals with Ease
Whether you're pursuing fitness milestones, learning new skills, or developing better habits, MotivePlus provides the structure and encouragement you need:

✓ Visual Goal Setting – Create clear, actionable goals with progress tracking ✓ Milestone Celebrations – Recognize your achievements to build lasting momentum ✓ Personalized Dashboard – See your journey at a glance with customizable views ✓ Habit Streaks – Build consistency with visual streak tracking and don't break the chain!

🔔 Stay On Track with Smart Notifications
Receive timely, personalized reminders that keep you focused on what matters most. Our intelligent notification system adapts to your habits and schedule for maximum effectiveness.

🌟 Premium Features:
🚀 Advanced Analytics – Gain deeper insights into your patterns and progress ☁️ Cloud Backup – Keep your goals and achievements secure across devices 🔄 Cross-Device Sync – Access your motivation system anywhere 🔒 Enhanced Privacy – Additional security features for your personal journey

💪 Join the Motive+ Community!
Join thousands of users transforming their lives one goal at a time. Our supportive community and regular feature updates ensure you're always moving forward.

📱 Download Motive+ today and start your journey toward lasting change!

quotes.text:
I Taught Myself to Code in 60 Days to Build an App That Helps People Grow

⸻

Hey Hacker News,

Two months ago, I didn’t know how to write a single line of code.

But I did know this: I needed to change my life—and help others do the same.

For years, I tracked my goals and habits using the Notes app on my phone. It wasn’t flashy, but it kept me grounded while I worked long days, trying to support the people I love.

Eventually, I realized I couldn’t wait for someone else to build the tool I needed—I had to build it myself.

So I committed to learning to code, even though I had zero background. For the past 60 days, I’ve put in 16-hour days: working my job, learning to code, and building every screen, feature, and animation on my own.

The result? Motive+ — a personal growth and habit-building app designed to help people get focused, stay consistent, and feel in control of their progress.

I just launched it for pre-registration on Google Play:
 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.motiveplusapp

It’s not perfect yet. But it’s real. It works. And I’m improving it every day based on feedback from early users.

If you’re someone who:
 • Loves building better habits
 • Is working on goals that actually matter
 • Believes small steps can create real change

…then I’d love for you to try Motive+.

I’m just one person — but I’m on a mission to help millions.
If you’re willing to be part of that journey, I’m eternally grateful.

Let’s change lives. For the better.

— …
